# Repository maintenance policy

PallasTrade is maintained exclusively by Steven Bian. This repository does not
accept external code contributions or pull requests.

## Bug reports and support

Public bug reports and feature requests may be submitted through the
[PallasTrade issue tracker](https://github.com/stevenbian9266-cyber/pallastrade/issues).
External pull requests will be closed without review.

Do not disclose security vulnerabilities in a public issue, discussion, or pull
request. Report them privately to
[stevenbian9266@gmail.com](mailto:stevenbian9266@gmail.com).

## Internal changes

Changes made by the maintainer must use an internal branch, pass the repository
CI and release gates, and be merged into the canonical `main` branch. No
Contributor License Agreement or external contribution sign-off is used.
